summary: No new blocking finding in this bounded packet. The blue Studio composition is retained while asset-only graph rows, one selected-object toolbar, quieter commands, readable Inspector groups, light menus and construction details visibly improve the working hierarchy. PX-CONSTRUCT-01 and the upper-wall phone concern are repaired in the fresh media. Production regressions and development-only photo workflow have separate dispositions and limitations.

findings.observation: Classroom now reads as a classroom with desks/chairs, whiteboard and clock; gallery reads as a gallery with three framed paintings, plinth sculptures and bench. Front-angle captures expose the previously problematic wall artwork, and 390px dark/light phone views keep the upper wall details below the viewport toolbar. Native-size classroom phone inspection confirms the entire clock circle is clear.
findings.limit: Recognizable approximate generic benchmarks; no surveyed physical dimensions or comprehensive artwork quality acceptance.
